courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 非球面光學加工
related.transfer: 可遷移「濺射去除的物理與去除率」與「面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；非球面光學加工的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Sputter removal physics and removal rate" and "Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Aspheric-optics manufacturing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以濺射去除函數與駐留時間反卷積，把拋光後的面形誤差收斂到奈米級；非球面光學加工則以非球面矢高方程、中頻誤差、確定性拋光、鑽石車削與模造、非球面量測與對心公差為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on converging polished figure error to the nanometre level with a sputter removal function and dwell-time deconvolution; Aspheric-optics manufacturing centres on aspheric sag equation, mid-spatial-frequency error, deterministic polishing, diamond turning and molding, asphere metrology and centring tolerances, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「氬離子束與工件表面」與「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到非球面光學加工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” and “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Aspheric-optics manufacturing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 磁流變光學拋光
related.transfer: 可遷移「濺射去除的物理與去除率」與「面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；磁流變光學拋光的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Sputter removal physics and removal rate" and "Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Magnetorheological optical finishing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以濺射去除函數與駐留時間反卷積，把拋光後的面形誤差收斂到奈米級；磁流變光學拋光則以以磁場硬化的磁流變液帶、Preston 去除關係與去除點校正，確定性修正非球面面形為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on converging polished figure error to the nanometre level with a sputter removal function and dwell-time deconvolution; Magnetorheological optical finishing centres on deterministic aspheric figure correction with a field-stiffened MR ribbon, Preston removal relation and spot calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「氬離子束與工件表面」與「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到磁流變光學拋光，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「誤差預算、收斂率與軌跡紋理」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” and “MR ribbon and electromagnet”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Magnetorheological optical finishing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Error budget, convergence ratio and tool-path texture", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 離子束光學表面修形
history.text: 柵極離子源源自 1960 年代 Harold Kaufman 在 NASA 為電推進發展的寬束離子源；1980 年代末新墨西哥大學與 Eastman Kodak 把它用於光學面形修正，Kodak 的離子束修形設備在 1990 年代初為 Keck 望遠鏡的 1.8 m 六角分段鏡完成最終修形，證明這種非接觸、確定性的製程能把大型非球面收斂到數十奈米。此後德國的研究機構與設備商把束寬縮小、把去除函數校正與反卷積軟體標準化，現在 ESO 極大望遠鏡的主鏡分段也在拋光後以離子束做最終修整。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Gridded ion sources descend from the broad-beam sources Harold Kaufman developed at NASA for electric propulsion in the 1960s; in the late 1980s the University of New Mexico and Eastman Kodak applied them to optical figure correction, and Kodak's ion-beam figuring facility finished the 1.8 m hexagonal segments of the Keck telescope in the early 1990s, proving that a non-contact deterministic process can converge large aspheres to tens of nanometres. German research institutes and equipment makers then narrowed the beam and standardised removal-function calibration and deconvolution software, and today the primary-mirror segments of the ESO Extremely Large Telescope receive ion-beam finishing after polishing. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「濺射去除的物理與去除率」到「驗收規格換算與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Sputter removal physics and removal rate" through "Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
